svg.text: Count ELECTRONS, not atoms: components where the numbers differ
Top: structure. Bottom: the p orbitals that react, with the electrons each one brings (dots). Grey = not part of the reacting component.
same atoms as the cation, opposite class
[2+2]: only the C=C, as π2a (L15 p.6–7)
Only neutral all-carbon polyenes have atoms = electrons (ethylene 2/2, butadiene 4/4, hexatriene 6/6). Sources as noted under each panel.
